name: makegood-units
title: Make-good units (pre-agreed, capped, zero-cost replacements)
description: Lets the buyer pre-authorize the seller to add zero-cost replacement units when the seller misses a deliverable or under-delivers, within a cap, a time window, and sameness rules (such as the same creator, platform, or creative format). A unit the seller adds under a rule is an ordinary core package with budget 0; this extension records why it exists and lets the buyer check that it stayed inside the rule. Anything outside a rule is a seller offer (core offer lane), not a make-good unit.
origin: Make-good terms survey: capped zero-cost make-good/bonus units (IAB/4A's T&Cs v3.0 VII(b), Goldbach, SevenOne, Calm 90-day window, Creators Agency 'one scoped extra deliverable')

extends.semantics: Readback of the make-good units the seller issued under the rules, each pointing at its zero-cost core package. Same uri@digest as the accepted rules.

The buyer asks the seller to issue a make-good unit under an accepted rule for a missed deliverable. The seller answers accepted, with the zero-cost package that carries the unit, or rejected, with a reason.

promotion.rule: 2+ independent adopters across two channels for 90+ days

changelog.change: Current version: the contributed task request_makegood, a branch of the kernel's task union with request and response definitions, spec rules MG-R18 to MG-R22, and a storyboard. Also: make-good rules in commercial_terms, the media_buy_state ledger, the normative spec, the conformance suite, and the reference code, all pinned by the digest. Uses the kernel container ExtensionEntry with `data`, and the host properties `extensions` and `extensions_state`. The spec and manifest text follow the documentation style guide; the rules and their IDs are unchanged.
